services.desc: Discover the thrill of Avalon Parasailing and experience the unparalleled beauty of Catalina Island from a whole new perspective. Located in the heart of Avalon along the waterfront, our parasailing adventures offer a unique blend of excitement and serenity, allowing you to soar high above the sparkling waters of the Pacific Ocean while taking in breathtaking panoramic views of the island’s rugged coastline, thriving marine life, and charming harbor. Our Avalon Parasailing experience is designed for adventure seekers of all ages. Whether you’re a first-time flier or a seasoned parasailer, our expert team ensures a safe and exhilarating ride.
